title: Engine._sample_checkpoint_loop pickles entire online arrays every 60s
issue: Runs every 60 seconds and calls _checkpoint_online_samples() which pickles the entire online sample arrays (features, y_fill, y_markout) via pickle.dump(). As online samples accumulate (thousands of rows with 25 features each), this becomes a large blocking I/O operation on the event loop.
impact: Event loop stall during pickle serialization + disk write. Grows with sample count.
suggestion: Write incrementally (append-only format like parquet/msgpack) or batch to background thread via asyncio.to_thread(). Consider checkpointing only delta since last save.

title: Engine._retrain_fill_model runs 5-fold CV on every retrain (5 min)
issue: Called from _retrain_fill_model() every 5 minutes. Does KFold cross-validation (n_splits=5) over all fill rows, fitting a HistGradientBoostingRegressor 5 times per retrain. Each fit is O(n_samples * n_features * max_iter).
impact: CPU-intensive blocking work on event loop every 5 min. Scales with fill sample count.
suggestion: Move CV to background thread (asyncio.to_thread). Cache CV results and only recompute when online fills increase significantly. Consider reducing folds or using a single holdout split for periodic validation.

title: Engine._restore_online_samples iterates and appends one-by-one O(n) on restart
issue: Restores checkpointed online samples by iterating through arrays and calling list.append() for each row (lines 3712-3717). With thousands of samples, this is O(n) Python loop overhead on startup.
impact: Startup latency proportional to checkpointed sample count. Blocks engine start.
suggestion: Use list.extend() with sliced arrays or numpy concatenation. Or restore via FillTrainingStore.from_arrays() which already supports bulk loading from arrays.

title: Merger.gas_cost_for makes synchronous RPC call in async context
issue: Calls w3.eth.get_transaction_receipt(tx_hash) synchronously (line 143) which blocks the event loop waiting for Polygon RPC response. Called from _merge_task() via asyncio.to_thread() but the RPC call itself is not async.
impact: Blocks thread pool worker during RPC round-trip (100-500ms). If called frequently, exhausts thread pool.
suggestion: Use async web3 provider (web3.AsyncHTTPProvider) or batch receipt fetches. Consider caching recent receipts since gas_cost_for is called immediately after merge.

title: RiskManager.begin_day / rollover_if_new_day both query SQLite for day anchor
issue: begin_day() calls self._store.get_day_anchor(day) (line 146). rollover_if_new_day() calls _today() and potentially reset_day() which calls _persist_day_anchor() (line 171). Both hit SQLite. Day anchor changes only once per UTC day.
impact: Unnecessary SQLite round-trips on every maintenance loop (2 min) and startup.
suggestion: Cache day anchor in memory. Only persist on actual day change or daily-loss latch. begin_day() already loads once at startup; rollover_if_new_day() should check cached anchor first.

title: _filter_quotes_by_fill_model recomputes OFI trend, trade rate, size anomaly every quote cycle
issue: In _recompute_locked() (lines 2735-2757), OFI trend, trade rate, and size anomaly are computed from scratch every quote cycle. These are passed to _filter_quotes_by_fill_model() which recomputes extract_features() for each quote.
impact: Redundant computation on hot path (every book update). OFI history and trade sizes are filtered/sliced repeatedly.
suggestion: Maintain running estimates (EWMA) for trade_rate, size_anomaly, ofi_trend updated incrementally in _on_trade(). Pass precomputed values to _filter_quotes_by_fill_model().

title: FillModel.validate() runs cross-validation on every call
issue: validate() calls holdout_metrics() which does 5-fold CV over fill rows (line 526). Called from _load_persisted_fill_model() on startup and _retrain_fill_model() every 5 min. CV is expensive and results don't change between calls unless new fills added.
impact: Repeated expensive CV computation. Blocks event loop during validation.
suggestion: Cache validation results keyed by (n_online_samples, n_online_fills). Only re-validate when online fills increase by a threshold (e.g., 10%). Move to background thread.

title: DeepSeekAgent creates new httpx.AsyncClient per instance; no shared connection pool
issue: Each DeepSeekAgent instance lazily creates its own httpx.AsyncClient (line 132-139). Engine creates one agent, but GovernedDeepSeekAgent, OversightLoop, MarketDiscovery all wrap the same agent. However, if multiple agents are instantiated (e.g., in tests or future multi-agent setups), each gets separate connection pool.
impact: Wasted TCP connections, no connection reuse across agents. DNS resolution and TLS handshake repeated per agent.
suggestion: Use a shared httpx.AsyncClient at module level or pass a pre-configured client. Configure limits: httpx.Limits(max_connections=20, max_keepalive_connections=10).
